Passion fruit Guava Beverage Processing Line

Contact
  • +86-18616619098
  • info@shjoylong.com
  • Description
  • Parameter
  • Video

Passion fruit Guava Beverage Processing Line

Suitable for processing of passion fruit, guava to produce clear juice, turbid juice, juice concentrate, etc. This production line is mainly composed of cleaning machine, sorting machine, elevator, peeling crushing machine, belt press, enzymolysis system, horizontal decanter, homogenizer, degasser, sterilization machine, filling machine equipment, etc. This production line design features advanced design idea, high degree of automation; Main equipments are all made of high quality food grade stainless steel, accords with the hygienic requirements of food processing.


* Capacity varies from 3tons/day to 1000tons/day. 

* Able to handle passion, guava

* Can produce clear juice, turbid juice, juice concentrate 

* Production line configuration is flexible, according to customer's different requirements in processing technology and finished product

* Special peeling and crushing machine to work at high efficiency

* Belt press type to yield juice without damaging seed at a high rate.

* Build-in CIP system to make clean easy

* Material contact part of the whole system is 304 stainless steel material, fully meets the food hygiene safety requirements.

Technical Parameters

Raw material

Passion fruit, guava

Finished product

Clear juice, turbid juice, juice concentrate

Capacity range

3tons/day to 1000tons/day

Brix of juice

15~20Brix

Brix of concentrate

36~65Brix

Package options

Ring-pull can/ tetra pak /oral liquid bottle/PET

Design capacity

According to clients’ requirements
